{{Quote|Wait a minute, you've never heard of Wroonians? C'mon, they're about as near-Human as you can get while still having that cool attitude about them. Some of my best smuggler contacts are Wroonians.|[[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]|<ref name="Smuggler's Log">{{JournalCite|7|Smuggler's Log}}</ref>}}
The '''Wroonians''' were a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned species of [[Near-Human]]s from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], a world in the same [[Sector/Legends|sector]] as the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Wroonian.png|thumb|left|130px|A Wroonian starfighter pilot]]
Wroonians could be distinguished from baseline [[Human/Legends|Humans]] by their [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and yellow irises. They shared physical characteristics with the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] people.<ref name="DBSP">{{DB|species|pantoran|Pantoran}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
Wroonian society was wealthy, fun-loving, and deeply spiritual; as a result, Wroonians often wore ornate clothing and [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]. Their culture focused on personal gain and material wealth. They were easy going and jovial, with a general resentment of authority.<ref name="AE" />

Wroonians loved travel both at [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] and in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. 

Around the galaxy, they were renowned for telling boastful, long, and perhaps exaggerated stories.<ref name="SOTE">{{WEGCite|story=The Weekly Luncheon|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

==History==
A well-traveled [[Species/Legends|species]], they were represented in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]]<ref name="DBCCE">{{DB|character|chieekway|Eekway, Chi}}</ref> and later were part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. There were numerous Wroonian colonies, such as on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].

==Behind the scenes==
While Wroonians had been part of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] for years, the first Wroonian to appear in the ''Star Wars'' movies was played by [[George Lucas]]. However, after the airing of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Trespass]]," [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida's]] species was changed to a [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]], meaning that the Wroonians no longer appear in the ''Star Wars'' movies, though they may have a link with the Pantorans.<ref name="DBSP" />
